In this paper, we

focus on those pure sheaves supported on curves, which are called one-dimensional sheaves. In contrast to the positive rank case, there are few general results for the moduli space of one-dimensional sheaves. An essential difficulty is that the supports of one-dimensional sheaves can be singular, even non-reduced. To distinguish this case, we use the following notation.
